answer_1.quote: We finally evaluate the capabilities of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve our task... We used a "base" variant of the Flan-T5 model, and fine-tune it on our own training data... The objective is reconstructing protowords (orthographic and phonemic forms) from modern cognates.

answer_2.quote: The metrics used include accuracy, (normalized) edit distance, and Cov_i , with i ∈ {1,5,10}, which stands for an extended version of the accuracy metric...

answer_4.quote: Linguists from our team manually analyzed the entire list of results, and we present the most significant observations regarding the models' successes and failures.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators (linguists) inspected each reconstructed protoform and judged whether it matched linguistic expectations, sound change regularities, and correctness relative to the dictionary etymon.
